rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00000.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「The transfer is complete.
　...How do you feel, $$ブルー$$?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00002.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I see.
　That is good to hear」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00003.text:
$$ブルー$$
（The captain's $$アスクレプス$$ has a jump system
　that can even breach the 《$$時の牢獄$$》...）
notes: Internal monologue retained. Captain is Blue's address for Advent, supported by scene and researched position.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00004.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「What is it, $$ブルー$$?
　Does everything you see seem so strange?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00005.text:
$$ブルー$$
「Y-yes, sir.
　I never imagined another Earth could exist
　beyond the $$時の牢獄$$...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00006.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「This emerald-green sea... If the Earth enclosed
　by the $$時の牢獄$$ is $$蒼の地球$$,
　then this must be $$翠の地球$$...」
notes: The source explicitly supplies color readings in Japanese. English color names convey the naming explanation; no extra literal gloss appended.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00008.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Here, we need no camouflage to evade
　《$$ジェミニス$$》 or the 《$$保守派$$》. You can
　restore your $$アスクレプス$$ to its original colors」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00010.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's better.
　My $$アスクレプス$$ is mine alone, after all」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00011.text:
$$ブルー$$
（Before we joined, after losing their patron
　《$$エルガン$$》 $$ローディック$$, the $$クロノ$$ 《$$改革派$$》
　were apparently on the verge of collapse...）
notes: Two keyword links remain in source order: Elgan, then Reformists. Surname uses Rhodic per dedicated Akurasu character list; base Roddick and story-summary Laudic variants are recorded in the glossary override.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00012.text:
$$ブルー$$
（But since the captain appeared with the
　$$アスクレプス$$, the $$改革派$$ have been regaining
　their strength, growing stronger than ever...）

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00013.text:
$$ブルー$$
（Just what are the captain and the $$アスクレプス$$...?）

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00014.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「$$コード：ブルー$$...
　I can understand your unease」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00016.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「But for now, I want you to trust me
　and follow my lead」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00018.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Thank you.
　Having you with me brings me joy,
　just like having 《them》」
notes: Kept the linked pronoun them; did not replace it with a later-story identification.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00019.text:
$$ブルー$$
「...Then, Captain...
　What exactly are we here on $$翠の地球$$ to...?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00020.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Before we discuss that,
　let us deal with our welcoming party」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00022.text:
$$ブルー$$
「$$ジェミニス$$...!
　Why are they here!?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00023.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「No, that's not quite right...
　We should call them $$サイデリアル$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00025.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's right.
　$$ジェミニス$$ is merely one unit
　within $$サイデリアル$$」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00026.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「To battle, $$ブルー$$!
　They are our enemies!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00028.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Prepare yourselves, $$サイデリアル$$!
　I will not let you do as you please
　with this world!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00030.text:
$$ブルー$$
「Captain...
　Just what is this $$サイデリアル$$...?」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00031.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「As I said,
　they are enemies of the $$クロノ$$ $$改革派$$...」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00032.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「In other words, those who distort
　humanity's evolution」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00033.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「$$サイデリアル$$...
　I will never tolerate your existence」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00034.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Foolish, powerless $$真徒$$s!
　You shall pay for your sins!」
notes: True Disciple is a proposed English label for researched 真徒; terminology needs review. Meaning is not replaced with ordinary soldiers.

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00035.text:
$$ブルー$$
「If they are no different from $$ジェミニス$$,
　then I will not hesitate to fight...!」

rengoku:STGZ3REN_00004:00036.text:
$$ブルー$$
「I will protect it, no matter what!
　Our blue planet!」
notes: Our blue planet is descriptive 蒼い星, not the exact proper-name form 蒼の地球; kept descriptive wording.
Isolated t_999 exclamation; reachability and purpose unverified. Kept a literal draft instead of dropping the record.
